unmapped_files.why: Each process's .command.{sh,run,out,err,log}, published by oncoanalyser 3.0.0 under logs/<group_id>/ and logs/other/: run records, not results.
The run's MultiQC report, published at the results root: the harvest links it to each D.SEQ as Link_QC itself; it is not a result to register.

REDUX's per-sample model tables beside its BAM (base-quality recalibration, duplicate frequencies, microsatellite jitter and repeat tables, the MSI prediction, the BQR plot). oncoanalyser's redux_dir restart reads them from the run folder; A.ALN has one secondary slot, which holds the index, and no Notes.

Bam Tools' per-sample coverage, fragment-length and flag-count tables. Their whole-genome coverage could fill A.ALN MedianCoverage and the 10x/30x shares, but no reader exists for bam_metric.summary.tsv yet (see the README, Outputs with no rule yet).
AMBER's B-allele frequencies and COBALT's read-depth ratios of the tumour and normal: inputs PURPLE fits purity, ploidy and copy number from, made from the pair.

SAGE's somatic and germline SNV/indel calls, their RNA-appended copies and PAVE's annotated copies. Each is made from the tumour and its normal (named after the tumour), so a row needs both as Parent, which no rule can express yet; sarek's map rules out its pair calls for the same reason.
ESVEE's structural-variant calls from the tumour/normal pair (pair-level, as SAGE's), its assembly tables and its read-preparation BAMs (intermediates).

PURPLE's purity, ploidy and copy-number fit, gene and segment copy number, driver catalogues and the final somatic and germline VCFs, plots and circos inputs: all made from the tumour/normal pair. A.CNV fits the copy number, but its row needs both samples as Parent (see the README, Outputs with no rule yet).
LINX's SV clustering, fusions, drivers and plots, from PURPLE's pair-level calls.
LILAC's HLA class I alleles and somatic HLA status, typed from the pair. A.HLA fits the alleles, but its row needs a reader for lilac.tsv's one-allele-per-row layout and both samples as Parent.

Homologous-recombination deficiency (CHORD), signature fits (Sigs), tissue of origin (CUPPA), viral integration (VIRUSBreakend, Virus Interpreter), telomere lengths (TEAL), IG/TCR CDR3 sequences (CIDER), neoepitopes (Neo), pharmacogenomic haplotypes (PEACH), RNA transcript abundance (Isofox), and the QSEE and ORANGE reports: no sample type holds any of them.
